_about: What beat you (main.gd note_hit / _loss_line): every hit the player takes is filed under a cause from his state and the move; a lost round ends on the biggest cause by damage, with its answer. Round 8: chip through a block and his bash are filed too, and the card names the top two causes and the rest, of your health.

light.name: his quick lights
light.answer: Keep your guard up close in (hold SPACE) and tap SPACE on the glint to parry.

heavy.name: his heavy swings
heavy.answer: Hold SPACE when he raises his weapon; he bounces off your guard: hit him then.

charged.name: the red unblockable
charged.answer: RED cannot be blocked: roll away (SHIFT) or hit him before it lands.

bash.name: his shoulder bash
bash.answer: A shoulder dip means BASH: roll (SHIFT) or strike him first.

traded.name: swinging into his swing
traded.answer: His blow was out first: block it, then strike in the gap after.

whiff.name: punished misses
whiff.answer: Strike only in reach (step in first); a miss leaves you open.

early_parry.name: parries tapped too early
early_parry.answer: Tap SPACE when the blow lands (on the glint), not when it starts.

guard_broken.name: hits after a broken guard
guard_broken.answer: Do not hold your guard against a bash; roll or bash back.

roll_end.name: hits at the end of your rolls
roll_end.answer: Roll through his swing, not before it: the end of a roll is open.

chip.name: blows on your guard
chip.answer: A held guard still costs health: tap SPACE on the glint to parry, or roll out.
